as_of_note: US closes for Thu 22 Oct 2026: AI selloff after Meta's results. S&P 500 -1.21% to 7,663.43 (worst day since July), Nasdaq -2.60% (worst since June), SOX -6.7%, Dow +0.02%, Russell 2000 +0.11%; equal-weight S&P +0.7%. META -7%, SPCX -9.1%, LRCX -11.8%, AMD -8.1%, NVDA -4.4%; PG +5.6%, BX +8.4%, LMT +7%. 10Y -19.3bp to 4.953% (biggest drop since Mar 2023), 2Y -18.5bp to 4.638%. Brent +4% to $113.17 (highest settle since May) on Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia; Comex gold -2.1% to $4,042.80. Oct hike odds 7.2% (CME FedWatch via Reuters). VIX 19.03. After hours: DECK -7% on a miss and weak guide, WDC -6% and BE -5% despite beats, RNG +14%. Evening futures flat (CNBC 7:08 PM ET).

mood.reason: S&P 500 -1.21% (worst since July) and Nasdaq -2.6% (worst since June) as Meta's negative free cash flow, record CDS and non-voting share plan revived AI-funding fears; SOX -6.7%, VIX +14% to 19.03, 10Y -19bp in a flight to safety and Brent at a five-month high. Tempered by a flat Dow, equal-weight S&P +0.7%, defensives rallying and flat evening futures.

risks: AI-funding stress spreading: Meta 5Y CDS at a record ~114.5bp, SOX now >26% below its June record, neocloud capital 'scarce' (Jensen Huang)
Middle East escalation: Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia, reports of US-Israeli plans for new strikes on Iran, and Iran threatening Gulf oil, cable and data-centre targets; Brent $113
Oil-driven inflation keeping a December hike (~77% priced) in play even as October odds fell to 7.2%
Hawkish 28 Oct FOMC surprise or hawkish guidance after the bond rally
Weak guides punished even on beats (LRCX -11.8%, WDC -6% and BE -5% after hours)
French fiscal stress spilling into euro credit

themes.title: AI trade cracks again on Meta
themes.explanation: Meta beat but fell 7% on its first cash outflow in over a decade, a non-voting share plan to fund AI and record-high CDS; SOX -6.7%, AMD -8.1%, LRCX -11.8%, SPCX -9.1%, Nasdaq 100 -2.9% (~$1.2T market cap lost, Kobeissi).

themes.title: Rotation, not panic
themes.explanation: Dow +0.02%, Russell 2000 +0.11%, equal-weight S&P +0.7%; staples +3.3%, utilities +2.1%, health care +1.3%, financials and real estate +1.1%; PG +5.6%, BX +8.4%, LMT +7%. NYSE advancers edged decliners.

themes.title: Flight to Treasuries
themes.explanation: 10Y -19.3bp to 4.953%, the biggest drop since March 2023, and 2Y -18.5bp; October hike odds fell to 7.2% from 27.7% a week ago (CME FedWatch via Reuters). Homebuilders +3.8%, regional banks +2.5%.

themes.title: Oil up, gold down
themes.explanation: Brent +4% to $113.17 on Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and US diplomats ordered out; gold -2.1% to $4,042.80 and silver -5.9% as funds raised cash rather than bought havens.

themes.title: Labour market still tight
themes.explanation: Initial claims fell to 194k vs 200k expected, lowest since July, keeping the Fed focused on inflation.
